The `minds_pool_slice_count` dispatch input on the minds release run now defaults to 6 rather than 5. The default tracks the remote-workspace test roster plus two spares (see `specs/remote-workspaces-in-ci.md`), and the roster gained a fourth slice-consuming test, `apps/minds/deployment_tests/test_pool_slow_path_create.py`, which leases a slice and rebuilds its container to check the slow (rebuild) create path.
